xerj def — find where a symbol is defined (go-to-definition, no scripts) Default ranking is lexical: it matches the words you typed, and it is not a neural reading of the code. USAGE: xerj def [OPTIONS] "" OPTIONS: --url node endpoint (default $XERJ_URL or http://localhost:9200) --prefix

one index prefix to search (default "ax" — what `xerj autoindex` writes); no comma lists --api-key Authorization (or $XERJ_API_KEY; --insecure nodes need none) -k number of definitions to return (default 5) --kind filter by symbol kind (function, class, method, ...) --lang filter by language (python, rust, typescript, ...) --json print the raw response instead of formatted definitions EXAMPLE: xerj def IOSIntfLine # exact identifier -> its declaration xerj def "euler angles to rotation matrix" # plain words also resolve the definer SEE ALSO: xerj search "" ranked passages when you don't know the name
